title: Thailand and Cambodia Agree on Ceasefire to End Weeks of Deadly Fighting
excerpt: Thailand and Cambodia have agreed to a ceasefire, bringing hope to the region after weeks of deadly clashes along their border. This truce aims to restore peace and stability while addressing long-standing territorial disputes.
metaDescription: Thailand and Cambodia agree on a ceasefire to halt weeks of deadly border fighting and restore regional peace. Details on the agreement and its impact.
